description: This file is a React component named EnhancedWorkflowOverview that provides a detailed visual overview of a workflow's status, timeline, agents, executions, and metadata within a web client UI. It uses React hooks and UI components to display data-driven cards and grids.

methods.name: EnhancedWorkflowOverview
methods.description: React functional component that displays a comprehensive overview of a workflow including status, timeline, agents, recent executions, and metadata. It accepts props such as workflow summary, DAG data, VC chain, and node selection handlers.

methods.name: StatusRow
methods.description: A helper React component that renders a row with an icon, label, and value, used to display various status metrics within the overview.
